supported_subset: One complete gzip member containing an unsegmented WARC1.0/1.1 response with nonchunked identity-encoded UTF8/ASCII HTML, exact byte range and date/digest checks.
limits: Caller must independently authenticate index and range metadata. Matching digests are consistency checks, not claim truth or domain ownership certification.
preliminary_fixture_correction: Initial positive fixture used request Range syntax in response Content-Range; corrected synthetic fixture, production parser retained standard response syntax.
